about: EUPHONIUM's fight references (milestone 3, Template F): the config, the two look fights, the scenario fights, the statistics against FLUTE and the coverage table
cache_files: cache files are under studio/reference/.cache/m3/ and pinned in pins.json

coverage.rule: required = every event kind and hit sub-kind ("hit/<what>") in at least require_fights of the statistics fights, the fighter's three abilities and spec.fights.must; a row is an item's first occurrence over the scenario fights (the earliest t; a tie goes to the scenario listed first, then the lower seed): its scenario and seed (rules in `scenarios`), t, after_fight = t - t_fight, its index in the events and the event

left.why: the lowest statistics seed with EUPHONIUM in the left corner winning and all three of its abilities firing, and a K.O. after 44 s, which the kit's checks need (passed over for an earlier K.O.: seeds 6, 8, 9, 13, 14, 15, 17, 18, 20, 22)

right.why: the lowest seed with FLUTE in the left corner winning (so EUPHONIUM is knocked out)

definitions.both_lows_share: share of all n fights in which both desperation moves (lows) fired
definitions.decided: fights with a K.O. before rules.t_max (winner not null)
definitions.fit_rate: fits / n, over all n fights (a fight with no K.O. never fits)
definitions.fits: fights whose score() fits is true
definitions.ko_median: numpy median of t_ko over ALL n fights, a fight with no K.O. counting as 99.0 s (kit/tuning.py; also how kit/story.py score treats it)
definitions.ko_median_decided: numpy median of t_ko over the decided fights only
definitions.ko_p10: numpy percentile 10 (linear) of the same list as ko_median
definitions.ko_p90: numpy percentile 90 (linear) of the same list as ko_median
definitions.lead_changes_mean: mean of lead_changes over all n fights (fights with no K.O. included)
definitions.left_wins: decided fights the left fighter (names[0]) won
definitions.names: the fighters, left corner first: index 0 is the left fighter in winner and win_share
definitions.win_share: left_wins / decided: the left fighter's share of the decided fights (fights with no K.O. left out), as kit/tuning.py
definitions.winner_hp_median_decided: numpy median of winner_hp over the decided fights
